race.title: Midnite Built Different Handicap (Div 1)
race.verdict: MEHMAR surely has a race in him soon for Jack Jones judged on his fine run at Wolverhampton on Tuesday and his supporters can gain compensation here. Multiple C&D scorer Sir Rodneyredblood should be all the better for his reappearance last week and appeals as the chief threat ahead of Dashing Donkey and Solid Bond . MEHMAR (IRE) SIR RODNEYREDBLOOD DASHING DONKEY
